title: Backend, Concurrency & Data Architecture
summary: I choose each technology based on the concrete use case: Django for bespoke enterprise ERPs requiring deep relational modeling and proven security; FastAPI for ultra-fast APIs; and Gin (Go) or WebSockets when real-time messaging and high concurrency are critical.

title: Linux Infrastructure, Docker & Production Deployment
summary: When traditional shared hosting falls short for asynchronous workers, task queues, or distributed services, I manage Linux servers from the ground up: everything containerized and orchestrated in Docker, hardened with firewalls, reverse proxies, and transactional email pipelines.

title: Process Automation, Scraping & AI Data Workflows
summary: I turn manual operational processes into measurable automated workflows: unattended Playwright bots for complex web extraction, Chrome Extensions (Manifest V3), and cost-effective document reading and structuring powered by AI.

title: High-Performance Web, Mobile & IoT Integration
summary: On the web I build fast, clean interfaces with Astro, Tailwind CSS, and HTMX without unnecessary overhead. On mobile I deliver fluid native experiences with Flutter published on Google Play, alongside custom hardware and IoT integrations.
